flora: Fiddlehead (tightly coiled young frond, covered in soft brown hairs/scales)
Tree Fern Frond segment (close-up showing delicate, feathery leaflets)
Spore Sori (underside of a leaf showing small, circular spore cases)
Young Tree Fern sapling (emerging from a mossy base)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; focus on the fuzzy texture of the fiddlehead and the delicate, lace-like pattern of the fronds; high tactile quality.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant or tiled composition: one section features a large, fuzzy, coiled fiddlehead; another shows the underside of a frond with spores; another shows a feathery green frond segment; the last shows a tiny emerging sapling.
visual_logic.ground: Soft, damp forest floor with patches of moss and decaying leaf litter.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, dappled forest light, diffused and gentle to highlight textures.
